input: Learn the basics of video editing on my laptop

gold.taskTitle: Learn Basic Video Editing on My Laptop
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to learn the fundamentals of video editing using their laptop.

questions.title: What operating system does your laptop run?
questions.description: Knowing whether the laptop runs Windows, macOS, or Linux determines which software options are available.

questions.title: Which video editing software do you plan to use?
questions.description: Identifying the target software (e.g., DaVinci Resolve, iMovie, Premiere Pro) focuses the learning path.

questions.title: What is your current level of video editing experience?
questions.description: Understanding whether the user is a complete beginner or has some prior exposure shapes the starting point.

questions.title: What type of videos do you want to edit?
questions.description: The genre or purpose of the content (e.g., travel vlogs, short films, YouTube tutorials) influences which skills to prioritize.

questions.title: How much time per week can you dedicate to learning?
questions.description: Knowing the available time helps structure a realistic and paced learning schedule.

questions.title: Do you have a specific deadline or target milestone?
questions.description: A deadline or goal date (e.g., finish a first edited video in one month) helps set urgency and pacing.

questions.title: Do you prefer learning through videos, articles, or hands-on practice?
questions.description: The preferred learning style determines whether to recommend YouTube tutorials, written guides, or project-based practice.
